front.title: Gender Representation in the IETF Nominating Committees

abstract.t: This document extends the existing limit on nomcom representation by organization ([RFC8713], Section 4.17) so that not all voting members of the IETF Nominating Committee (nomcom) belong to the same gender. It guarantees up to three voting seats to volunteers who opt into a self-declared pool, and changes the selection only in years when a plain random draw would seat fewer.
